minimum_n_policy.rule: Each question must freeze an owner/event-structure-specific minimum-N rule before any outcome query. No Edge-Stats default such as N=10/N=30 is imported as framework semantics.
minimum_n_policy.fail_closed: If a defensible minimum-N rule cannot be frozen without inspecting target outcomes, the question remains MAPPING_BLOCKED.

questions.availability_semantics: Prospective packet timestamp only; missing axes remain UNKNOWN and are never inferred.
questions.eligibility: A prospective first ETH/BTC cross above the existing registered read-only level with immutable source packet hash.
questions.conditions: Existing first-cross baseline plus frozen available rotation axes.
questions.lookback: No retrospective discovery lookback; sequence starts at prospective first cross.
questions.outcome: Persistence versus failure/reversal of the frozen rotation attempt.
questions.overlap_rule: Overlapping observations belong to the same active sequence and are not independent rows.
questions.holdout_boundary: Chronological holdout required after a fixed horizon is owner-frozen.
questions.regime_split: Existing framework regime only when point-in-time owner binding exists.
questions.blocker: Current T6 runtime measures event duration/reversal but does not freeze the fixed forward horizon required by CEE Stage A.

questions.availability_semantics: Reversal is recorded prospectively when ETH/BTC returns below the registered first-cross level.
questions.eligibility: Same prospective sequence population as CEE-Q01.
questions.lookback: None beyond frozen owner state at first cross.
questions.missingness_rule: No inferred failure; right-censored sequences remain incomplete.
questions.overlap_rule: One sequence is one dependency cluster.
questions.holdout_boundary: Chronological holdout required after horizon repair.
questions.blocker: Failure event is defined, but no fixed evaluation horizon is frozen.

questions.source_dataset_id_or_binding: Existing T4 prospective event/outcome rows only; no retrospective pseudo-rows.
questions.availability_semantics: Only source-backed matured T4 horizons available at or after due time.
questions.eligibility: Existing registered pullback edge events with valid prospective source and maturity lineage.
questions.conditions: Already-defined framework stress/pullback event, not qualitative Mild/Moderate/Large/Extreme labels.
questions.missingness_rule: Unmatured horizon is UNKNOWN/right-censored, never failure or success.
questions.overlap_rule: Same pullback event across multiple maturity horizons is one event cluster.
questions.holdout_boundary: Future chronological T4 events after Stage B merge are the untouched prospective holdout.
questions.regime_split: Only existing point-in-time regime tags carried by eligible event rows.
questions.blocker: Existing T4 owner and 24H/72H/7D outcomes are mapped, but Stage A requires a defensible event-structure-specific minimum-N rule to be frozen before outcome queries.

questions.source_dataset_id_or_binding: T4 prospective events; qualitative pullback labels explicitly excluded.
questions.availability_semantics: Owner policy forbids mechanical drawdown classification from qualitative labels until exact measurement anchors/bands are frozen.
questions.conditions: Would require an already-defined risk/stress state with reproducible drawdown anchor.
questions.outcome: Deeper adverse move after stress state.
questions.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN until exact drawdown metric and anchor exist.
questions.blocker: Current canonical pullback policy explicitly suspends mechanical qualitative drawdown classification.

questions.source_dataset_id_or_binding: Current event-scoped reclaim/survival gates exist, but no frozen distinct durability denominator/outcome contract was found.
questions.availability_semantics: Current event gates are operational context, not a preregistered reclaim-durability outcome study.
questions.conditions: Would require a frozen settled reclaim event identity.
questions.missingness_rule: Do not infer from narrative event history.
questions.blocker: A separate CEE-compatible denominator/horizon contract does not currently exist; do not create one merely to fill the ten-question slate.

questions.source_dataset_id_or_binding: Direct settled ETH/BTC owner plus prospective T6 sequence rows.
questions.availability_semantics: Direct settled ETH/BTC only; derived ratio has no gate authority.
questions.eligibility: Prospective direct ETH/BTC state with valid source timing.
questions.overlap_rule: Repeated observations inside one sequence are dependent.
questions.blocker: Current owners define state/persistence but not a separate fixed CEE outcome horizon.

questions.source_dataset_id_or_binding: Prospective breadth state only where constituent continuity and point-in-time membership are valid.
questions.availability_semantics: Comparable breadth history is explicitly a prospective evidence gap; changed/dynamic cohorts cannot be treated as persistence.
questions.eligibility: Only fixed/comparable breadth cohorts with point-in-time membership.
questions.missingness_rule: Changed or unavailable cohort => UNKNOWN / non-eligible.
questions.overlap_rule: Repeated overlapping cohort observations are one dependency cluster.
questions.blocker: Comparable breadth continuity is not currently sufficient for a clean fixed-horizon Stage B execution mapping.

questions.source_dataset_id_or_binding: Existing ETF owner adapter and queued experiment contract.
questions.availability_semantics: Timestamp-safe existing-owner join required; no duplicate ETF calls.
questions.overlap_rule: Matched control windows per existing experiment.
questions.minimum_N_rule: Existing experiment owner; CEE does not create a parallel test.
questions.blocker: CEE-Q08 is materially owned by an existing queued transmission experiment and is therefore retained as a duplicate/null mapping, not a new executable question.

questions.source_dataset_id_or_binding: Existing point-in-time/vintage-correct macro owner data only.
questions.availability_semantics: Publication/knowledge time must precede crypto outcome; revised history is descriptive unless vintage-correct.
questions.conditions: At least two of three macro stress components active for two eligible publication days, as owner-defined.
questions.outcome: Crypto transmission and later outcome rate.
questions.horizon: Existing owner contracts differ; CEE must not invent a competing horizon.
questions.missingness_rule: Missing trigger inputs => UNKNOWN and non-enumerable.
questions.holdout_boundary: Global-liquidity owner preserves chronological holdout; CEE does not duplicate it.
questions.minimum_N_rule: Existing owner; no parallel CEE execution while semantics remain owned elsewhere.
questions.blocker: The framework already has frozen macro-transmission semantics and an economic-execution lock. CEE must not create a parallel owner.

questions.availability_semantics: Only real prospective decision-divergence rows; no retrospective horizon selection.
questions.eligibility: Existing T2 WAIT-vs-BTC_PARTIAL divergence captured after activation and attached to valid maturity receipts.
questions.outcome: Damage avoided versus missed upside / false-exit cost.
questions.missingness_rule: Derived metrics remain null until authoritative FNP evaluator exists.
questions.overlap_rule: One decision divergence is one event cluster across its three frozen horizons.
questions.blocker: Current T5 runtime explicitly blocks derived FNP metrics because the authoritative evaluator is not yet available.

stage_b_summary.next_bounded_action: Do not query outcomes. Resolve only owner-native blockers, including per-question minimum-N rules, fixed horizons and missing evaluator contracts, without inventing substitute questions or parallel owners. Shared statistical primitives may be centralized independently if they remove verified duplication.
